name: Garen
title: The Might of Demacia

Q.name: Decisive Strike
Q.description: Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains 35% Move Speed for 1.4/1.95/2.5/3.05/3.6 second(s). His next Attack Silences for 1.5 seconds and does 30/60/90/120/150 + 1.5×AD physical damage.
Q.summary: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

W.name: Courage
W.description: Passive: Garen has ? bonus Armor and ? bonus Magic Resist. Killing units permanently grants 0.2 resists, up to a max of 30. Active: Garen steels his courage for 4 seconds, reducing incoming damage by 25/29.0/33/37/41%. He also gains 65/85/105/125/145 + 0.18×bonus max HP Shield and 60% Tenacity for 0.75 seconds.
W.summary: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.

E.name: Judgment
E.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword for 3 seconds, dealing 4/7/10/13/16 + 0.4/0.43/0.46/0.49/0.52×AD physical damage (varies) times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes 25% increased damage. Champions hit by 6 strikes lose 25% Armor for 6 seconds. Recast: Garen ends this Ability early.
E.summary: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

R.name: Demacian Justice
R.description: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing 125/200/275 plus 25/30/35% missing Health true damage.
R.summary: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

Passive.name: Perseverance
Passive.description: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.
Passive.summary: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Durable, simple bruiser who wins short trades with Q silence + E spin, sustains out of combat and executes with R.
strengths: strong level 1–3 trades if Q lands
weaknesses: falls off against ranged champions and tanks
Q is dodged/parried by Jax E and Fiora W
profile.curveNote: Strong with Q alone early, but wants Q+E+W (level 3) for real trades.

Q.notes: Next attack silences; removes slows on cast. Dodged by Jax E, parried by Fiora W (silence is not immobilizing).

W.notes: Tenacity doesn't reduce airborne (e.g. Darius E pull).

E.notes: Spin; area damage (Jax E takes reduced damage); not an attack.

R.notes: Execute, true damage; can be parried by Fiora W.

profile.windowAgainst: W down, or Q down (no silence, no slow cleanse).
